title: AutoEnergyDesign: An LLM-Driven Agent for Automatic Energy System Design Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.35160v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Designing building energy systems is a high-dimensional, mixed-integer search problem: when each design is evaluated by a year-long simulation, black-box optimizers typically need hundreds of evaluations. This paper presents AutoEnergyDesign, a framework in which a Large Language Model (LLM) agent reasons over previous simulation results, proposes configuration changes and learns in context from each outcome, while a git-based mechanism automatically reverts unsuccessful changes. The agent couples a reasoning model with an explicit memory organisation (procedural, semantic, episodic and reflective), a constrained action interface and an environment-grounded keep/revert signal. The simulator covers eight technologies (photovoltaics, micro-wind, combined heat and power, solar thermal, gas boilers, batteries, heat pumps and inverters) and computes the 25-year Net Present Cost (NPC), including capital and operating costs and salvage value. translated_title: AutoEnergyDesign：一种由大语言模型驱动的自动能源系统设计优化智能体
translated_abstract: 设计建筑能源系统是一个高维度、混合整数的搜索问题：当每个设计方案都需要通过长达一年的仿真来评估时，黑盒优化器通常需要数百次评估。本文提出了AutoEnergyDesign，这是一个由大语言模型（LLM）智能体驱动的框架，该智能体对先前的仿真结果进行推理、提出配置变更，并通过上下文从每次结果中学习，同时基于git的机制会自动回退不成功的变更。该智能体将推理模型与显式记忆组织（程序性、语义性、情景性和反思性记忆）、受限动作接口以及基于环境的保留/回退信号相结合。仿真器涵盖八种技术（光伏、微型风机、热电联产、太阳能光热、燃气锅炉、电池、热泵和逆变器），并计算25年净现值成本（NPC），其中包含资本成本、运营成本和残值。
tldr: 该论文提出AutoEnergyDesign框架，利用具备多类型显式记忆和git式自动回退机制的LLM智能体，通过仿真反馈进行上下文学习来自动优化建筑能源系统设计，从而大幅减少黑盒优化所需的仿真评估次数。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AutoEnergyDesign, a framework in which an LLM agent with multi-type explicit memory and a git-based automatic reversion mechanism learns in context from simulation feedback to automatically optimize building energy system designs, substantially reducing the number of simulation evaluations required by black-box optimizers.
